tickets.title: Collect Client Tax Documents
tickets.text: Request and organize current tax documents for Anika Pebblefizz, including prior-year federal and state returns, W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, estimated tax payment records, charitable giving summaries, and any tax notices. Track missing items and route complete packet to the planning team. Obtain the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary and deliver them securely by 2024-04-18.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Resolve Velvet Acorn Income Variance
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the IRS‑reported $14,860 ordinary dividends and the $7,440 shown on the return worksheet for Anika Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn taxable account.
tickets.evidence: resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate Secure Delivery of Tax Documents
tickets.text: Coordinate with Beren Nettlewhisk to send the IRS notice, the relevant tax forms, and the account statements to Anika Pebblefizz via secure delivery.
tickets.evidence: Anika authorized coordination with Beren and requested that only the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements be sent through secure delivery by April 16, 2024.
